plainTranslation: A's love and values meets B's feelings. The trine lets them flow together easily.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.

summaryDeep: Their affection, preferences, and wish to keep things pleasant work smoothly with your feelings, needs, and sense of safety. It runs easily and asks little, quietly steadying the rest of the bond. Lean on how naturally this one lines up.
tension: The challenge is not conflict so much as taking each other for granted. When something feels this natural, it is easy to assume it will take care of itself. You may stop noticing the small things that make the relationship work because they have become so familiar.
advice: Do not coast on good chemistry. Keep showing up. Keep making the effort to connect. The warmth between you is a gift, but it is not self-sustaining. The relationships that last are the ones where people keep choosing each other.
summaryShort: Their affection, preferences, and wish to keep things pleasant work smoothly with your feelings, needs, and sense of safety.
